name: PaletteShare
author: Annerose
description:
https://github.com/Aneroze/SokuPaletteShare

v1.10
- if both players install PaletteShare mod they could show palette to each other, if one not install then there will be fallback default palette
- Ctrl+P to disable OpponentPalette, you will see 
- S(card switch) key to change your fallback palette
- go Deck Construction menu, and hover on a character name, press C to see PaletteShare menu, also when netplay if you enable EasyDecks mod
- Opponents' custom palettes are auto saved to `PaletteShare\saved` as `<character>-<profile>-NN.pal` ; a save hotkey (Ctrl+S) can be turned on in the ini instead.
- Save both sides' custom palettes with your replays in <replay name>.meta.json next to the .rep files, then anyone enabled PaletteShare mod watching this rep could see both sides custom palettes
- check `PaletteShare.ini` for config
